typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		client_nbr as string,
		FAIL_QTY as string,
		security_adp_nbr as string,
		settlement_dt as timestamp,
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		SPIN as string,
		cusip_nbr as string,
		Currency as string,
		EffDate as timestamp,
		TAG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		client_nbr as string,
		FAIL_QTY as string,
		security_adp_nbr as string,
		settlement_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		SPIN as string,
		cusip_nbr as string,
		Currency as string,
		EffDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TAG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		client_nbr,
		FAIL_QTY,
		security_adp_nbr,
		settlement_dt,
		FAIL_AMT,
		SPIN,
		cusip_nbr,
		Currency,
		EffDate,
		TAG),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
